metadata.description: Deterministic guardrails that make Claude Code agents more trustworthy — for everyone.

plugins.name: proof-gate
plugins.description: Blocks a 'done / tests pass / fixed' claim unless a test or build actually passed after your latest code edit, and flags tests weakened to fake a green.

plugins.name: dependency-change-guard
plugins.description: Checks pinned dependency versions against npm/PyPI/crates before an install or manifest edit — flags hallucinated pins, yanked/deprecated releases and silent downgrades. Fails open.
